title: Approve a composition
question: Närvarostämpeln is locked. Which first-screen composition should the Flutter build match?

options.label: Stamp as the lecture
options.thesis: The circular date stamp is the session. Three form rows. One copy action.
options.viewport: Phone brief: huge circular 1 SEPT stamp, three municipal rows, Kopiera till skolplattformen.
options.risk: The stamp can steal space from the brief you actually copy.

options.label: Stamp as a header band
options.thesis: A rectangular ink band names the lecture; the brief reads as one letter; copy lives in the thumb zone.
options.viewport: Full-width date band, continuous three-block letter, Kopiera bar at the bottom.
options.risk: Reads closer to a generic form if the band is just a colored header.

options.label: Just stamped
options.thesis: Most of the screen is the press of the stamp; the brief is a carbon slip you pick up after.
options.viewport: Top half empty paper and a huge stamp; bottom half a short three-line slip and a circular Kopiera.
options.risk: Beautiful ritual, less brief on screen — desk users may want more text.
